about: Where the source code of libvips-42.dll and libvips-cpp.dll is, and of every library inside them, for the source offer in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt (GPL-3.0 s.6(d), which LGPL-3.0 s.4(d) uses: the source may sit on a third party's server, with clear directions next to the object code; MPL-2.0 s.3.2(a) for cairo). Each url names no version: scripts/gen-third-party-notices.js fills {vips} with the vips version in the installed @img/sharp-win32-x64's versions.json and {sharp} with that package's version. It refuses when the installed package is not the version 'checkedFor' names, so a sharp bump forces the chain in 'checked' to be read again, out of that version's own build scripts, before a build can carry it.
checked: 2026-11-20, read only (GitHub's API and raw files, npm registry metadata, HTTP HEAD; nothing downloaded). (1) npm @img/sharp-win32-x64@0.33.5 has gitHead fc32e0bd, the commit of sharp's tag v0.33.5. There, npm/from-github-release.js fills the win32-x64 package's lib/ from the release prebuild sharp-v0.33.5-napi-v9-win32-x64.tar.gz and copies versions.json and the README's third-party table from @img/sharp-libvips-win32-x64 (a devDependency, 1.0.4); .prebuildrc packs src/build/Release files matching (sharp-.+\.node|libvips-.+\.dll); src/binding.gyp's copy-dll target copies <(sharp_libvips_lib_dir)/libvips-42.dll there (lib/libvips.js: @img/sharp-libvips-win32-x64/lib), and its libvips-cpp target builds libvips-cpp.dll on Windows from libvips' C++ sources (@img/sharp-libvips-dev/cplusplus). (2) npm @img/sharp-libvips-win32-x64@1.0.4 has gitHead cb57c8e0, the commit of sharp-libvips' tag v8.15.3, whose LIBVIPS_VERSION is 8.15.3; its CI runs ./build.sh $(cat LIBVIPS_VERSION) win32-x64, and build/win.sh downloads https://github.com/libvips/build-win64-mxe/releases/download/v${VERSION_VIPS}/vips-dev-w64-web-${VERSION_VIPS}-static.zip, removes that zip's own libvips-cpp-42.dll, and packs its DLLs and versions.json. (3) libvips/build-win64-mxe has the tag v8.15.3 (commit 953ed027e18ac38f3cb388d2290fd84cdee15cfb) and the release v8.15.3 (2024-08-12, neither draft nor pre-release) carrying vips-dev-w64-web-8.15.3-static.zip (10,742,603 bytes). At that tag every LGPL and MPL library is pinned by version, URL and sha256, each equal to versions.json: vips 8.15.3 (build/vips-web.mk, which also writes versions.json), glib 2.81.1, pango 1.54.0, fribidi 1.0.15, librsvg 2.58.93 and libexif 0.6.24 (build/overrides.mk), libheif 1.18.2 (build/libheif.mk), proxy-libintl 0.4 (build/plugins/proxy-libintl), and cairo 1.18.0 (MXE's src/cairo.mk at the MXE revision build/build.sh checks out, e56eebec2a9f578c12a495851a76256d93b71ac0). For a newer sharp, read the same files at its tag: from-github-release.js (or what replaced it), .prebuildrc, src/binding.gyp, lib/libvips.js, and sharp-libvips' build/win.sh at the commit its npm package names.
